suppliers.title: Supplier Register
suppliers.description: Third-party vendors and their cybersecurity risk profiles. Required by NIS2 Art. 21(2)(d).
suppliers.helpText: Register all ICT suppliers, cloud providers, and service vendors. Assess each supplier's cybersecurity risk level and track contract security clauses. NIS2 requires you to manage supply chain risks and monitor supplier security posture.
suppliers.empty: No suppliers registered. Add your first supplier to track supply chain security.
suppliers.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this supplier?

fieldDescriptions.name: Legal or trading name of the supplier organization.
fieldDescriptions.description: Brief description of the services or products this supplier provides to your organization.
fieldDescriptions.contactEmail: Primary email address for security-related communications with this supplier.
fieldDescriptions.contactName: Name of the primary security or account contact at this supplier.
fieldDescriptions.riskLevel: Assessed cybersecurity risk level based on the supplier's access, criticality, and security posture.
fieldDescriptions.serviceType: Type of service provided (e.g., cloud hosting, managed security, software development, hardware).
fieldDescriptions.hasAccessToSystems: Enable if this supplier has direct or remote access to your IT/OT systems.
fieldDescriptions.hasAccessToData: Enable if this supplier processes, stores, or has access to your organization's data.
fieldDescriptions.isCritical: Enable if disruption of this supplier's services would directly impact your essential services under NIS2.
fieldDescriptions.contractStartDate: Date when the contract with this supplier became effective.
fieldDescriptions.contractEndDate: Date when the contract expires or is due for renewal.
fieldDescriptions.hasSecurityClauses: Enable if the contract includes specific cybersecurity requirements and obligations.
fieldDescriptions.hasIncidentNotificationClause: Enable if the contract requires the supplier to notify you of security incidents within a defined timeframe.
fieldDescriptions.hasAuditRights: Enable if the contract grants you the right to audit the supplier's security practices.
fieldDescriptions.hasSubcontractorFlowDown: Enable if security requirements are contractually flowed down to the supplier's subcontractors.
fieldDescriptions.nis2RegistrationId: If this supplier is NIS2-regulated, enter their BSI registration number. Allows you to reference their compliance status.
fieldDescriptions.hasSecurityCertification: Enable if this supplier holds a recognized security certification (ISO 27001, SOC 2, BSI C5, etc.).
fieldDescriptions.securityCertificationType: Type of certification held (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, BSI C5, TISAX).
fieldDescriptions.contractSecurityClauses: Specific security clauses in this supplier's contract (SLAs, audit rights, incident notification, data handling, termination obligations).
fieldDescriptions.auditFrequency: How often this supplier is audited for security compliance.
fieldDescriptions.monitoringMethod: How this supplier's security posture is monitored (e.g., questionnaire, SecurityScorecard, SOC 2 review).
fieldDescriptions.lastReviewDate: Date of the most recent security review for this supplier.
fieldDescriptions.dueDiligenceProcess: Due diligence performed when onboarding this supplier (e.g., questionnaire, cert check, reference call).
fieldDescriptions.relationshipType: Under GDPR: is this supplier a processor (Art. 28), joint controller (Art. 26), separate controller, or internal? Drives which contract obligations apply.
fieldDescriptions.processesPersonalData: Enable if any personal data flows to or through this supplier (triggers GDPR-specific contract obligations).
fieldDescriptions.processesOnlyOnInstructions: Art. 28(3)(a) — the processor only processes personal data on documented instructions from the controller.
fieldDescriptions.assistsWithDataSubjectRights: Art. 28(3)(e) — the processor assists you in responding to data subject requests (access, deletion, portability).
fieldDescriptions.internationalTransfer: Enable if personal data is transferred outside the European Economic Area (EEA).
fieldDescriptions.transferMechanism: Legal mechanism for the cross-border transfer: adequacy decision, SCCs, binding corporate rules, or derogation.

suppliers.unlinkedRisks: Risks not linked to any supplier
suppliers.noSuppliersYet: No suppliers registered. Add suppliers in step 5.1 first.
